source: A new bridge opened in the city center on Monday after three years of construction. Officials said it will cut the average commute across the river from forty minutes to under ten, and is expected to carry about twenty thousand vehicles a day.
target: A new city-center bridge opened Monday after three years of work, cutting cross-river commutes from 40 to under 10 minutes and expected to carry ~20,000 vehicles daily.

source: Researchers reported that a common soil bacterium can break down a type of plastic used in packaging. In lab tests the microbe degraded thin films within six weeks, though the team cautioned that real-world conditions may slow the process.
target: Scientists found a soil bacterium that breaks down packaging plastic, degrading thin films in six weeks in the lab, though real-world results may be slower.

source: The national weather service issued a heat advisory for the weekend, urging residents to stay hydrated and avoid outdoor activity in the afternoon. Temperatures are forecast to reach record highs in several districts.
target: A weekend heat advisory warns of record highs; residents are urged to stay hydrated and avoid afternoon outdoor activity.

source: A local cooperative of women weavers has begun selling its handwoven textiles online, reaching customers in other states for the first time. Sales in the first month exceeded the group's expectations and have funded two new looms.
target: A women weavers' cooperative started selling handwoven textiles online, reaching other states; strong first-month sales funded two new looms.

source: The city council voted to extend library hours on weekends and add evening sessions during exam months, responding to requests from students who said quiet study space was hard to find.
target: The council extended weekend library hours and added exam-season evening sessions after students requested more quiet study space.

source: A regional airline announced three new routes connecting smaller towns to the state capital, with introductory fares for the first two months. The carrier said the routes aim to improve access to medical and government services.
target: A regional airline added three routes linking small towns to the capital, with introductory fares, to improve access to medical and government services.
